Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include only either a 2-color green card or a Tamer card with [Shu-Chong Wong] in its name, can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a 2-color green card and a Tamer card with [Shu-Chong Wong] in its name, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 2-color green card and 1 Tamer card with [Shu-Chong Wong] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When ＜Alliance＞ suspends one of your Digimon, this Digimon may digivolve into a 2-color green Digimon card in your hand for the cost. When this Digimon would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.
